nom: La Roche-Posay Hyalu B5 Eye Serum with Hyaluronic Acid & Caffeine

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including several around the eye area, consistently report the fragrance-free formula causes no irritation.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated under-eye skin report the gel serum noticeably rejuvenates and hydrates the area within about a week.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the serum meaningfully hydrates and plumps the under-eye area, though a few, including one who found the area felt drier and made wrinkles more noticeable, and another who felt it sat on the skin without absorbing, disagree.
concerns.aging: Many reviewers report softer, less noticeable fine lines and a firmer under-eye area after consistent use over several weeks, but some saw no visible change, and one reviewer felt the product thinned her under-eye skin and made wrinkles more visible.
concerns.spots: Reviewers frequently credit the caffeine and roller applicator with brightening dark circles and reducing puffiness within one to two weeks, though a couple say they saw only a mild difference or none at all.

aspects.libelle: Feels tacky or sticky until fully absorbed
Small bottle size for the price
Thin, runny texture can drip if overused
Layers well under makeup without pilling

extraits.texte: Based on the reviews I read, I expected my experience with this product to be either miraculous or horrible. I got no tacky feeling after applying, no tightening of the undereye skin, no reaction whatsoever. I applied the product with my finger in order to have full control & avoid applying too much, like some people seemed to do. After leaving it in place overnight, my undereye area looked and felt dry and the wrinkles more pronounced. At my age I can't afford that!

extraits.titre: It's a no from me Dawg
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As I near 50, I'm noticing fine lines around my eyes. I don't mind them so much, but I'm willing to experiment with age-defying treatments. Honestly, this product didn't work for me. It thinned the skin under my eyes, making purple veins more visible, as well as the wrinkles!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Absolutely love this eye serum! It deeply hydrates, smooths fine lines, reduces puffiness, and noticeably brightens dark circles. The formula feels gentle on my sensitive skin and absorbs quickly without any greasy residue. Plus, the light, refreshing scent makes it a pleasure to use every day. A must-have in my skincare routine!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] If you're on the hunt for an eye serum that actually does what it says, the La Roche-Posay Hyalu B5 Eye Serum might be your new best friend. First off, it's fragrance-free, which is a big plus if you have sensitive skin around the eyes. I've been using it for a couple of weeks now, and the results are pretty impressive. The formula is packed with two types of hyaluronic acid, which means my under-eye area is staying hydrated all day. I've noticed a visible reduction in the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles—nothing dramatic, but definitely smoother and plumper. Dark circles? Yeah, this stuff helps with that too. Thanks to the 10% complex (caffeine, niacinamide, and HEPES), the skin around my eyes feels a lot less tired, and the dark shadows are noticeably lighter. The real game-changer here is the applicator. The rollerball is not just a gimmick—it's cooling, soothing, and feels super refreshing first thing in the morning (or after a long day). I also love how it absorbs quickly and doesn't leave any greasy residue, which means I can go about my day without worrying about it interfering with makeup or looking too shiny. Overall, it's a solid addition to my skincare routine and definitely makes my eye area look more awake and youthful.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The skin near my eyes are my so dry and damaged from not taking care of them properly and I'm so happy to have started seeing some benefit after just using this serum for 1 week. It's become so much more rejuvenated already! Excited to see what it looks like at the one month mark!

extraits.titre: So hydrating for severe dry skin
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this hyaluronic acid. It is so hydrating, seamless, non-sticky, and wonderfully applied. The applicator is cooling and really feels like Im treating my skin well. Ive had such a nourishing glow on my skin after using this. Cant wait to restock! Definitely worth it!
